messages:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — Lunar Labs go-live handshake tomorrow 10am PT. I put together a tiny customer-facing checklist for prefill/prefix caching, batching config, and streaming fallbacks we can share in the kickoff call. Posting here for review.

Owen (CS Ops): thanks! can we include a one-line curl for them to validate streaming? keeps demos less flaky. :thumbsup:

Maya (CS): yes. short checklist first, then curl + suggested config snippet. also a note about renewal risk flags to watch in first 7 days (high error rate, repeated timeouts, low token consumption).

Devon (SRE): add a quick bit about warm pools and jittered prefill to avoid thundering herd. Recommend prefill window: 5–15 minutes depending on expected surge.

Maya (CS): agreed. draft below. please skim for technical accuracy and tone. Lina — tagging you so you can preview what we'll send the customer in the kickoff.

Lina (Customer): thanks — looks concise. please call out which metrics we should track in our dashboard so my PM can watch.

Maya (CS): good point. I'll call out three priority metrics: 1) 95th percentile completion latency, 2) token consumption per session, 3) streaming disconnect rate. Also add note: enable verbose logs for first 48h and keep them for 7 days.

Owen (CS Ops): config snippet for batching/prefetch to drop into their config:
```
# Recommended client-side guidance
# 1) Prefix cache: prewarm with top-10 prompts via /v1/prefill using a small concurrency (2-4)
# 2) Server batching: target batch_size 8–16, batch_timeout 10ms for low-latency demos
# 3) Streaming: enable keepalive ping every 30s, fallback to short-poll at 500ms if disconnects > 3/min
```

Devon (SRE): small tweak: batch_timeout 8ms if using dedicated capacity and 12ms for hosted (more noisy). Also recommend KV cache TTL 1h for demo teams, increase to 6–12h in production if prompt templates stable.

Maya (CS): adding curl test for streaming validation (one-line):
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams -d '{"model":"xx-demo","prompt":"ping","stream":true}'
```

Maya (CS): suggested customer-facing checklist (one-pager):
- Preflight (24h before): run prefill for top prompts, validate successful 200 responses, check kv-cache hit rate > 60%
- Day 0 (demo): set batch_timeout conservative (12ms hosted / 8ms dedicated), enable streaming keepalive, monitor 95p latency and error rate live
- Day 1–7 (monitor): keep verbose logs, watch token consumption vs. estimate, flag any repeated disconnects or tail latency > 2x baseline as renewal risk signals

Lina (Customer): great — can you add a snippet for client backoff if they see 503s? we want to show resilience plan.

Owen (CS Ops): sure — add exponential backoff with jitter and an immediate circuit-breaker after 5 consecutive 503s for 60s. Note: recommend automatic fallback to a smaller model variant if errors persist > 2 minutes.

Maya (CS): capture feedback loop: ask the customer to fill quick telemetry form after the demo (3 fields: perceived latency, correctness hit-rate, any streaming hiccups). We'll use that to trigger a follow-up to tune batching/cache.

Devon (SRE): I'll add an ops play: if streaming disconnect rate > 1% for 10m, trigger auto-scale and notify oncall with runbook link.

Maya (CS): perfect. final ask: @enablement-bot can you attach the single-page PDF and a short email template we can send to Luna (Lunar Labs) before kickoff?

enablement-bot: Attached: lunar-prefill-checklist-v1.pdf and kickoff-email-template.txt (links).

Owen (CS Ops): LGTM. Maya — I'll join the call and walk through the checklist. Lina — we'll keep it lightweight and iteratively tune after first 24h. :white_check_mark: 

Maya (CS): thanks team — I'll send to Luna now and post a shortened version in the kickoff doc. If anything else pops up, reply here and I'll update the PDF. :rocket:
